command: fabio lakehouse iceberg-commit-table --workspace <WS> --id <ITEM> --namespace dbo --table native_table --file engine-commit.json --dry-run
description: Preview an exact native-table commit without changing caller-supplied optimistic requirements. No rows, manifests or data files are written by fabio.

warnings: Review all optimistic requirements. Never drop assertions or rebase a stale commit automatically.

notes: Commit/delete previews perform read-only scope validation. Execution reports status:acknowledged, destructive:true, retriable:false and an observation with scopeVerified and metadataLocationMatchesAcknowledgement. Neither observation proves event/query readiness or continued isolation. A conflict requires inspection and a newly reviewed engine request, never assertion removal/replay. Delete additionally requires --expected-table-uuid; its snapshot guard is not atomic, and catalog absence does not prove physical purge.
